svg.title: Ycash vaults and Yellowback: reference architecture
svg.desc: How the Ycash nodes (ycashd and koganyd), the light-client stack, the desktop wallet, the mining pool, the explorer, x402 payments, the bridge attestor and the operations tooling fit together, with the protocol on every connection.
svg.text: Ycash vaults and Yellowback: reference architecture
Everything the Ycash developers build and run, by layer. Every client reaches a node only through its public interface; the node is the only place a rule lives.
non-custodial: keys never leave the device
YEC and YED; Sapling and post-quantum too
chain value pools, live chain dashboards

Envoy on EKS · proxy on the lightwallet host
the Ycash full node (C++) · JSON-RPC · P2P
same overlay; changes land here first
same network and rules: vaults, YED, post-quantum
node lines interoperate block for block
Helm chart (kind, EKS) · Terraform EC2 hosts
for seeds, pool, explorer, lightwallet, x402

each release builds into the node
Static sites on S3 + CloudFront; testnet services on one EC2 host each; the light-wallet backend also runs on EKS or kind.
badge: a rule or index inside the node, not a separate process
